mission_01: Congratulations! You have successfully implemented min-max scaling from scratch. You learned how the formula (x - min) / (max - min) transforms any numeric feature to the [0, 1] range. Min-max scaling preserves the original distribution shape while ensuring all features contribute equally to distance-based algorithms. Remember that min-max scaling is sensitive to outliers, as extreme values can compress the range of most data points. For outlier-resistant scaling, you will learn robust scaling in later missions.
